full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows a dark-haired young woman looking toward the camera from a close, shadowed setting. Her face sits near the center, tilted slightly downward and toward the right, while her eyes lift directly toward the viewer. Dark hair is gathered close to the head, with a small curled strand crossing one cheek and a thicker braided or twisted section falling beside the neck. Her brows and eyes are the most sharply defined features. The nose, lips, and pale cheek pass through a soft range of gray before merging with the surrounding dark clothing. A white collar peeks through below the chin, crossed by a dark bow or narrow tie at the neck. Most of the setting is indistinct. Blurred, pale shapes drift across the upper right and lower right foreground, partly veiling the hair and shoulder. The left side remains a deep mottled gray with faint photographic marks, making the illuminated face appear to emerge from an enclosed space. The foreground blur is not merely empty softness; it adds a layered, almost secretive feeling, as though the camera has found the face between nearby objects. The crop is tight at the top and sides, and there is little visible room or landscape to explain the scene. Light from the upper left lifts the forehead, cheek, and one eye, while the opposite side of the face and the clothing fall gradually into shadow. Fine grain and slightly worn tonal texture are visible across both bright skin and dark areas. The overall composition is intimate and watchful, with one direct gaze held between soft occlusions and a deep, quiet monochrome background.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白摄影呈现一位深发年轻女子，在贴近而幽暗的环境中看向相机。面孔靠近中央，略向下和右边倾，双眼却抬起直视观众。深色头发贴着头部收起，一缕小卷发横过脸颊，颈旁还有更厚的一段编发或盘发。眉毛和眼睛是最清楚的特征。鼻子、嘴唇和浅色面颊经过柔和灰阶过渡，最终融入周围的深色衣物。下巴下露出白领，被颈部深色蝴蝶结或细领带横过。环境大部难辨。模糊的浅色形状在右上和右下前景漂过，部分遮住头发和肩膀。左侧保有深而斑驳的灰色与淡淡摄影痕迹，使受光面孔像从封闭空间中浮出。前景模糊不只是空泛的柔软，它增加层叠、近乎私密的感觉，好像相机从近处物件之间发现这张脸。上下两侧裁切紧密，几乎没有可见房间或风景解释场景。光从左上方照亮前额、面颊和一只眼睛，脸的另一侧与衣服逐渐落入阴影。细颗粒与略磨旧的色调肌理在亮肤和暗部都可见。整体构图亲近而警觉，一道直接目光被柔和遮挡与深沉、安静的黑白背景夹住。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white photography uses selective focus, soft foreground occlusion, and fine tonal grain to create intimate depth. A few carefully lit focal details remain crisp, while adjacent dark forms and pale near shapes dissolve into haze. Mid-gray skinlike planes transition gradually to charcoal, avoiding hard cutout edges except at the strongest visual marks. The frame is close and asymmetrically veiled, so partial concealment contributes to the composition rather than hiding it. Small pale highlights rise from a broad dark field, with visible photographic wear in both. Light is directional but gentle, giving the focal area volume without a theatrical spotlight. The overall treatment is quiet, psychologically charged, and observational, with blur acting as an active layer of space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白摄影以选择性对焦、柔和前景遮挡和细密色调颗粒建立亲近的纵深。少量经精心照亮的焦点细部保持清楚，相邻深色形体和近处浅色形状则消融为朦胧。近似肤面的中灰平面逐渐过渡到炭黑，除了最有力的视觉笔点外，避免生硬剪纸边缘。取景贴近并被不对称地遮住，因此部分隐藏参与构图，而不是破坏构图。小浅亮部从宽阔暗色域中浮起，两处都有可见摄影旧痕。光有方向但温和，给焦点体积，却不形成戏剧性聚光。整体处理安静、富心理张力且重观察，柔焦成为主动的空间层。
theme_en: A dark-haired young woman looking toward the camera through soft foreground blur
theme_zh: 一位深发年轻女子隔着柔焦前景看向相机
name: Kati Horna
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
